- **`buildReport`** — recomputing `severityRank(worst)` inside each loop iteration was a redundant lookup; hoisted once.

Helpers kept are only ones standing for a genuinely separate job (validation, per-reading parsing, unit normalization, classification, aggregation, report assembly) — and two files-worth of indirection (`isNonNegativeInt` single-use helper) was removed by inlining.

Verified byte-for-byte identical behavior against the original via an exhaustive `classifySignal` sweep (−1000..2000) plus 2000 randomized batch inputs and edge cases: **ALL MATCH**.
